cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Every Loss Builds the Comeback
cards.instruction: Treat each setback as proof that the eventual victory will be more impressive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. My collapsed cake will make the next one look magnificent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. We'll begin the comeback with a new oven.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: An overnight oven installation. Now we have genuine suspense.
